metadata.title: Uniform estimates for complex Monge-Ampère equations: big cohomology classes
metadata.abstract: We prove uniform a priori estimates for solutions to degenerate complex Monge--Ampère equations in big cohomology classes, using both auxiliary-function technique developed by Guo, Phong and Tong [On $L^\infty$-estimates for complex Monge-Ampère equations, Ann. of Math. (2) 198 (2023), no.1, 393-418], and quasi-psh envelope approach developed by Guedj and Lu [Quasi-plurisubharmonic envelopes 1: Uniform estimates on Kähler manifolds, J. Eur. Math. Soc. (JEMS) 27 (2025), no. 3, 1185-1208.]. As an application, we apply our method to prove the Moser-Trudinger and Brezis-Merle-type inequalities for complex Monge-Ampère equations.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 为大上同调类中的退化复 Monge--Ampère 方程建立统一先验估计。
analysis.breakthrough: 把两条现代估计路线统一用于退化大类，并推出 Moser--Trudinger 与 Brezis--Merle 型不等式。
analysis.limitations: 摘要未列出测度密度、奇异集与常数依赖的精确假设。
